title: Service Dependency Matrix
purpose: All 13 services with inter-service edges (7 found), 4 controller→model bypass sites, and all external API integrations mapped to consuming services.
description: Complete dependency graph of the service layer showing which services call each other, which consume external APIs, and which controllers bypass the service layer to access models directly. Services are grouped by category (core business, storage, messaging, AI, email). The dynamic require() from support.service to message.service is highlighted as a coupling anomaly. Four controller→model bypass sites are documented where controllers skip their service layer entirely.

services.label: cryptoPayment.service.ts
services.description: Crypto wallet config, on-chain transaction verification (11-step verifyAndRecordBasePayment), processDebitCardOffRamp (mocked). Dependencies: Stripe external, Ethereum RPC external, supabase DB.

services.label: subscription.service.ts
services.description: Subscription CRUD, lifecycle management, Stripe API calls, welcome DM delivery. Calls cryptoPayment.service for on-chain verification on create. Calls message.service for welcome DM.

services.label: content.service.ts
services.description: Content CRUD with media processing (sharp/ffmpeg), access control, watermarking, reporting. Calls notification.service for subscriber broadcast. Calls storage.service for R2 operations.

services.label: creator.service.ts
services.description: Creator dashboard aggregation, analytics, earnings, payout requests, broadcast messages. Calls analytics.service for event counts. Calls cryptoPayment.service for payout verification. Calls storage.service for file operations.

services.label: admin.service.ts
services.description: Admin dashboard stats, user/content management, moderation, verification docs. Calls storage.service for signed URLs. Calls email.service for user messaging.

services.label: user.service.ts
services.description: Profile CRUD, gallery management, feed generation, onboarding, verification submission. Calls storage.service for avatar/doc uploads.

services.label: support.service.ts
services.description: Support ticket CRUD, admin reply with DM sync. Uses dynamic require() to call message.service for admin reply → DM delivery — an architectural anomaly.

services.label: notification.service.ts
services.description: Subscriber notification delivery (fire-and-forget), enriched notification retrieval. Reads from supabase DB for subscriptions, user profiles, content.

services.label: analytics.service.ts
services.description: Event logging (profile_visit, post_view, gallery_add), RPC calls for content view count increment. Writes to analytics_events table.

services.label: ai.service.ts
services.description: AI caption generation via OpenAI/OpenRouter SDK. Route selection based on API key prefix (sk-or-v1 → OpenRouter). Model: gemma-3-27b-it:free.

services.label: email.service.ts
services.description: SMTP email sending via nodemailer. Wired but unused—zero callers in codebase.

services.label: storage.service.ts
services.description: R2 object storage operations: upload (3-retry exp backoff), download, delete, signed URL generation. The only service with retry logic.

services.label: message.service.ts
services.description: Direct messaging CRUD, conversation management, mass message, Socket.IO event emission. Emits to Socket.IO for real-time delivery.

dataStores.label: Supabase PostgreSQL
dataStores.description: All 13 services read/write to this database. Tables: profiles, content, subscriptions, transactions, messages, conversations, analytics_events, reports, support_tickets, contests, referrals, enclave_applications.

entryPoints.label: Controller → Service call
entryPoints.description: Every controller function (except bypass sites) delegates business logic to its corresponding service. The service layer is the exclusive entry point for business operations.

exitPoints.label: JSON Response to Controller
exitPoints.description: Services return domain objects or throw AppError. Controllers format the response via ok()/created() helpers.

preconditions: All services must have their dependencies resolvable at import time
External API credentials must be configured in environment variables
Database tables must exist with correct schemas
postconditions: Service calls produce side effects (DB writes, external API calls, socket emissions) or return transformed data
All errors propagate as AppError instances to the error handler middleware

validationRules: All inter-service calls use static imports except support.service → message.service (dynamic require)
Services throw AppError for business rule violations—controllers never handle raw errors
Controller→model bypass sites should be refactored to use service layer
businessRules: Only storage.service implements retry logic (3 attempts, exponential backoff)
subscription.service delegates crypto verification to cryptoPayment.service—not duplicated
support.service dynamically requires message.service to avoid circular dependency
securityConsiderations: Controller→model bypass sites bypass service-layer validation and access control
support.service dynamic require is fragile and may fail silently
External API keys are consumed by services, never exposed to controllers
performanceConsiderations: creator.service makes 5+ parallel queries for dashboard data
admin.service makes 5 parallel queries for dashboard stats
Mass message (creator.service broadcast) iterates subscribers sequentially
content.service media processing (sharp/ffmpeg) is CPU-intensive and synchronous
